title: The Conflict Cycle Breaker
description: Interactive seven-stage family conflict ring with per-stage dialogue and ownership coding, five exit nodes carrying replacement sentences, sticky edge-cutting, and a run-one-turn animation that stops dead at any cut.
creator: Arun Batchu
subject: ADHD
Family Conflict
Communication
Systems Thinking
audience: Family members, People with ADHD, Couples

controls.label: Loop stages
controls.purpose: Open anatomy, dialogue, and who can act

controls.label: Exit nodes
controls.purpose: Cut the loop and show the replacement sentence

controls.label: Run one turn
controls.purpose: Animate the loop; a cut edge stops the turn
